## Change

Describe the user/product behavior changed.

## Dependency or custom subsystem choice

For non-trivial new functionality or a dependency, record:

- Capability and requirements
- Maintained GitHub + npm/crates.io candidates checked
- Selected option and why; rejected options and exact unmet requirements
- Security / Tauri capability impact
- Why custom code is necessary, if any

## Verification

Checks run and their outcomes; relevant desktop/platform evidence and remaining limitations.
Update the owning contract document when it changes.
